replace:
// a sheet added after the install goes unchecked
      cache = new WeakMap();
why: Stops checking sheets when jsdom clears its cache, so only the sheets present at install are guarded. A sheet appended later, by a test or by a module imported after the install, would carry a focus-state `display` rule in unseen.
killedBy: computed-style-cache: the focus-state guard a sheet added after the install is refused at the next read, and at every read after
